Careers at Zencity

Join the Zencity Team

and Impact the Way Government Organizations are Run

See Open Positions

We’re on a mission

to help local governments build trust in communities using cutting edge technology. Backed by top-tier partners, we’re seeking mission-driven, talented individuals to join our growing team of Zencitizens.

Trust matters –
join us in building it.

Hear from our team

Working at Zencity has been one of the most rewarding experiences of my career. The people here are sharp, supportive, and genuinely care about the work. We're helping cities actually understand and serve the people who live in them, and it feels good to be part of that.

Guy Customer Success Manager

It’s great to work with such amazing people here at Zencity. Each team member has a lot of impact on the product. I started here as a developer and became a team leader. There is a lot of room to grow and to influence. I really enjoy each day of my work!

Karin R&D Team Lead

Zencity's work environment fosters professional growth, a strong sense of teamwork and encourages working with passion. I am proud to be part of a company that is at the forefront of transforming how local governments engage with their communities. Our commitment to redefining community engagement is reflected in our culture, our cutting-edge technology, our teammates, and our clients' success in bridging the gap between local gov and the residents that they serve. 

Philly Account Executive
